description: This Java source file defines an immutable command record 'GLClosureCommand' used for handling accounting closure data in Fineract, including validation logic for creation and update operations.

classes.name: GLClosureCommand
classes.description: An immutable record representing an accounting closure command, with validation methods for create and update operations.

methods.name: validateForCreate
